title: CCX / PostgreSQL
description: CCX PostgreSQL datastores (postgres_exporter via cmon service discovery): health, replication, WAL, throughput, cache, locks, activity, vacuum and size.

panels.title: Node status
panels.description: pg_up per PostgreSQL node: UP when the exporter can connect to the server; click a node for host metrics.

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Primary or replica per node, from pg_replication_is_replica.

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Client backends (sum of pg_stat_database_numbackends) as a share of max_connections, per node.

targets.expr: sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (pg_stat_database_numbackends{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (instance) group_left () clamp_min(max by (instance) (pg_settings_max_connections{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}), 1)

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node with datastore, IP, PostgreSQL version (pg_static) and current role; PostgreSQL start time is not exported by this exporter configuration (no pg_postmaster collector).

targets.expr: max by (ClusterType, DatastoreName, ip, instance, job, short_version) (pg_replication_is_replica{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} * on (instance) group_left (short_version) pg_static{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Connections vs max_connections
panels.description: Client backends per node against the configured max_connections limit.

panels.title: Replication lag (time)
panels.description: pg_replication_lag_seconds on replicas only: 0 when the replica has replayed everything it received, otherwise seconds since the last replayed transaction (primaries are hidden).

panels.title: Replica WAL lag (bytes, from primary)
panels.description: pg_stat_replication_pg_wal_lsn_diff on the primary: bytes of WAL each standby has not yet replayed.

panels.title: Replication slot retained WAL
panels.description: pg_replication_slots_pg_wal_lsn_diff: WAL bytes retained by each replication slot; a growing line means a slot consumer is behind or gone.

panels.title: Replication slots
panels.description: Each replication slot with its WAL status (pg_replication_slot_wal_status) and whether it is active (pg_replication_slot_slot_is_active).

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, ip, job, slot_name, slot_type, wal_status) (pg_replication_slot_wal_status{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} == 1) * on (ip, slot_name) group_left () max by (ip, slot_name) (pg_replication_slot_slot_is_active{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Slot safe WAL size
panels.description: pg_replication_slot_safe_wal_size_bytes: WAL that can still be written before the slot is in danger of losing required WAL (max_slot_wal_keep_size).

panels.title: WAL size
panels.description: pg_wal_size_bytes: total size of the pg_wal directory per node.

panels.title: WAL segments
panels.description: pg_wal_segments: number of WAL segment files in pg_wal per node.

panels.title: WAL archiving
panels.description: Rate of WAL files archived and archive failures (pg_stat_archiver); failures should stay at zero.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second (rate of pg_stat_database_xact_*), selected databases.

panels.title: Rows read
panels.description: Rows returned by scans and fetched by index lookups per second (rate of tup_returned / tup_fetched).

panels.title: Rows written
panels.description: Rows inserted, updated and deleted per second (rate of tup_inserted / tup_updated / tup_deleted).

panels.title: Buffer cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers: rate(blks_hit) / (rate(blks_hit) + rate(blks_read)); gaps mean no reads in the interval.

targets.expr: sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Blocks read from disk vs cache
panels.description: Blocks per second found in shared buffers (hit) versus read from the OS/disk (read).

panels.title: Temporary files
panels.description: Bytes per second written to temporary files by sorts/hashes that exceeded work_mem (rate of temp_bytes).

panels.title: Locks by mode
panels.description: Currently held locks per lock mode (pg_locks_count), selected databases.

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks detected per second (rate of pg_stat_database_deadlocks). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (DatastoreName, ip, instance, job, datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_deadlocks{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Recovery conflicts
panels.description: Queries cancelled on standbys due to recovery conflicts per second, by conflict type (pg_stat_database_conflicts_confl_*).

panels.title: Sessions by state
panels.description: Backends per state (active, idle, idle in transaction, ...) from pg_stat_activity_count.

panels.title: Waiting sessions by wait event type
panels.description: Backends currently waiting, grouped by wait_event_type (Lock, IO, LWLock, Client, ...).

panels.title: Longest running transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction per node (pg_stat_activity_max_tx_duration); long values block vacuum and bloat tables.

panels.title: Buffers allocated
panels.description: Shared buffers allocated per second (rate of pg_stat_bgwriter_buffers_alloc_total). Checkpoint statistics moved to pg_stat_checkpointer in PostgreSQL 17 and are not exported here (only the pg_stat_bgwriter_*_total counters exist).

panels.title: Buffers written by bgwriter
panels.description: Dirty buffers written per second by the background writer (rate of pg_stat_bgwriter_buffers_clean_total). Checkpoint statistics moved to pg_stat_checkpointer in PostgreSQL 17 and are not exported here (only the pg_stat_bgwriter_*_total counters exist).

panels.title: bgwriter stopped (maxwritten)
panels.description: Times per second the background writer stopped because it wrote bgwriter_lru_maxpages buffers (rate of maxwritten_clean_total). Checkpoint statistics moved to pg_stat_checkpointer in PostgreSQL 17 and are not exported here (only the pg_stat_bgwriter_*_total counters exist).

panels.title: Sequential vs index scans
panels.description: Sequential and index scans per second on user tables (rate of pg_stat_user_tables_seq_scan / idx_scan).

panels.title: Autovacuum / autoanalyze runs
panels.description: Autovacuum and autoanalyze runs on user tables per interval (increase of the per-table counters).

panels.title: Top 10 tables by dead tuples
panels.description: User tables with the most dead tuples right now (pg_stat_user_tables_n_dead_tup); high values mean vacuum is behind.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (ip, datname, schemaname, relname) (pg_stat_user_tables_n_dead_tup{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}))

panels.title: Top 10 tables by size
panels.description: Largest user tables (pg_stat_user_tables_table_size_bytes), excluding indexes.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (ip, datname, schemaname, relname) (pg_stat_user_tables_table_size_bytes{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}))

panels.title: Top 10 tables by sequential rows read
panels.description: Rows read by sequential scans per second, per table (rate of seq_tup_read); candidates for missing indexes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ip, datname, schemaname, relname) (rate(pg_stat_user_tables_seq_tup_read{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: On-disk size per database and node (pg_database_size_bytes). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Current database size
panels.description: Latest size per database (largest replica value), selected databases.
